Lemos Farm 官方公布的 2026 南瓜季为 9 月 5 日至 11 月: Lemos Farm lists its 2026 pumpkin season as September 5–November 15. It opens on weekends and selected weekdays in September, daily in October and weekends in November. Check the available date and arrival slot before buying. The farm is at 12320 San Mateo Road on Highway 92 in Half Moon Bay.
编辑建议带年幼孩子先选两三项最想玩的体验，把吃东西和休息穿插进去。孩子不喜欢惊吓: For younger children, we suggest choosing two or three favorite activities and adding food and rest breaks. Check the Haunted House experience and skip it if your child dislikes scares. A child who loves trains or animals need not try everything to make the ticket feel worthwhile. An open attraction is not suitable for every child; follow onsite limits and your child’s energy.

Pumpkin picking, gem mining, face painting, animal feed and food are among the paid extras. An admission pass does not mean a free pumpkin to take home.
